title: Inter: 13 press claims this week, only 3 held up
caption:
Inter in the Italian press this week: 13 reported claims, 3 confirmed, 10 still open. Çalhanoğlu alone had three endings in six days — per Gazzetta dello Sport, then Sky Sport Italia, now Sabah. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
